label: Whatever is maximal in being is the first being, i.e. nothing other than it…, from NECESSARY_1 root
description: Classical conditional with excluded middle as an explicit premise, zero Lean axioms: whatever is maximal in being has nothing other than it simply prior to it, from restricted well-foundedness, the closing premise, the genus principle, two tertia via bridges and two bridges into the selected relation. Seven open non-logical premises for one; no discharge.
